title: Quantum optimization beyond QUBO for industrial logistics and scheduling
summary: The increasing complexity of industrial scheduling and transport routing problems motivates the study of alternative optimization formulations and computational paradigms. In this work, we study how higher-order unconstrained binary optimization (HUBO) formulations of such problems map onto quantum optimization workflows in both noisy and fault-tolerant regimes. We consider three representative logistics and manufacturing use cases and formulate each as a HUBO problem. This captures process intricacies, such as highly correlated assembly-line scheduling rules, which are difficult to express…
